line: They don't see it yet...
I was a quiet one, a kid nobody picked
Had a head full of words and a heart that wouldn't quit
Mama said, "Keem, you can make it if you try"
So I kept on building while the world just walked on by
And every door they closed on me
Just taught me how to make a key
So keep building, even when it falls apart
Every big thing started as a spark
If they tell you you're too small, too late, too far
Build your own world, build it where you are
Keep building, keep building
That's how Kemy got its start
Broke a hundred times before a single thing worked right
Fixed it in the morning, broke again by night
But somewhere a kid is laughing in a room I made
That's the reason why I never walked away
So if you're scared to take the leap
I was too, but I didn't sleep
So keep building, even when it falls apart
Every big thing started as a spark
If they tell you you're too small, too late, too far
Build your own world, build it where you are
Keep building, keep building
That's how Kemy got its start
Lone Keem, they didn't know the name
Lone Keem, but I'm still here, all the same
You don't need a crowd to start
Just a dream in a stubborn heart
Your dream doesn't need to be loud
Just keep going, make yourself proud
So keep building, even when it falls apart
Every big thing started as a spark
If they tell you you're too small, too late, too far
Build your own world, build it where you are
Keep building, keep building, building
Don't you ever lose that heart
Keep building, keep building
That's how Kemy got its start
They don't see it yet...
But they will
